annotations.text: Read-only for players. Events come from a staff-managed table (title, description, start/end, room, colour, host) - a Housekeeping resource in the CMS, or :addevent in chat. Friends' birthdays are the rp_user_birthdays rows of the player's friends list.

iOS day view: week strip (swipe or tap to change day, dots mark days with events, Today jumps back), all-day row for birthdays, hourly timeline from 3 PM (hotel evenings) with a now line. Tap an event for the sheet.
Alternate: an agenda list of upcoming days. Denser, no timeline - could also be a second tab in the day view.

Staff see a + in the header and Edit / Delete on any event sheet; players never do. Post/Edit/Delete go to the emulator, which broadcasts the change to every online client - open calendars redraw at once, no refresh. Edit reuses the New Event sheet pre-filled; Delete confirms first.
